title: T46 motion packs: clips_to_pack — video clips to an animated-tier pack (0.4.1)
head: t46-motion-packs
body:
## What

- Turns one video clip per state into an animated-tier ("More motion") pack in plain code
- Input: `<state>/*.png` frame folders plus sprite base the clips start from
- Keys out flat background using key color from border (soft alpha, spill clamp)
- Cuts each clip where it comes back closest to its first frame
- Picks N (4-12) evenly spaced frames from every clip
- Crops every frame of every state with one shared box (union of all, centred on resting pose)
- Quantises to one shared palette; reuses `portrait_to_pack`'s look (outline, rim, brooch, status, dims)
- Brooch skipped on frames where body has moved; sheets over 2 MB re-saved as indexed PNG
- Pack written by `render_pack` (`tier: animated`, `frames`, `fps`, rows per contract) and checked with `validate_pack`
- Optional contact sheet, all-states GIF, per-state GIFs for review
- `avatars/tools/extract_frames.swift` extracts frames via AVFoundation (no ffmpeg, no new dependency)
- Tests use synthetic frames only (`tests/test_avatars_clips.py`)

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

No ask-first gate or state mapping: an offline art tool that writes a pack folder; the pack is checked by validate_pack (tests/test_avatars_clips.py).
